item.title: GA Lottery Winners Keep Stacking Up: Your Essential Guide to Georgia's Biggest Prizes in 2026
item.description:
What if your next stop at a gas station turned you into a millionaire? For several Georgia residents, that dream became reality this month alone — and $48 million in scratch-off prizes were claimed across the state in just one recent stretch.

The GA Lottery is on a remarkable hot streak in 2026, with million-dollar winners popping up from Athens to Johnson County to Ludowici. Whether you play Powerball, Mega Millions, Cash 3, or scratch-offs, here’s everything you need to know about what’s happening — and what it means for you.

item.title: Powerball Winning Numbers: April 4 Drawing Results and the $231 Million Jackpot Rollover
item.description:
More than 601,000 people won prizes in Saturday night’s Powerball drawing — yet not a single ticket matched all six numbers needed to claim the grand prize. That means the jackpot just got bigger, and millions of players are already eyeing the next draw.

Quick Summary: The Powerball drawing on Saturday, April 4, 2026, produced no jackpot winner. The prize has rolled over from $216 million to an estimated $231 million (cash value approximately $105 million). The next drawing is Monday, April 7, 2026, at 10:59 PM ET.
